summary: Backend testing of property lead to showcase listing conversion with image transfer. All 9 tests passed (100%). The fix properly handles image transfer with graceful fallback for missing files.
passed_tests: POST /api/property-leads/{id}/convert-to-showcase returns 400 for already converted leads
Conversion with existing image files copies all images to listing directory
Conversion with missing image files succeeds gracefully (fallback to URL references)
Image metadata (id, filename, url, size, content_type) preserved during conversion
Pre-created test lead 4d7e397a (5 images) verified as converted with files intact
Pre-created test lead 5e3cadc9 (4 records, 0 files) verified as converted with fallback
Conversion response contains all expected fields (message, listing_id, slug, lead_id, showcase_url)

features_verified.image_copy_success: When source files exist, all images are copied from /app/backend/static/property-images/{lead_id}/ to /app/backend/static/listing-images/{listing_id}/
features_verified.image_copy_fallback: When source files are missing, conversion succeeds and preserves original image records with URL references
features_verified.graceful_error_handling: FileNotFoundError is caught and logged, but does not block conversion
features_verified.logging: [CONVERT] logs show detailed image transfer progress with ✓/✗ status for each image
features_verified.status_update: Lead status correctly updated to 'converted' with converted_to_listing_id field set
features_verified.response_structure: API response includes listing_id, slug, lead_id, and showcase_url

seed_data_creation: Used pre-created test leads from agent_to_agent_context_note
context_for_next_testing_agent: The convert-to-showcase endpoint (/api/property-leads/{id}/convert-to-showcase) image transfer logic has been fixed and tested. Key behaviors: 1) When files exist, they are copied to /app/backend/static/listing-images/{listing_id}/ 2) When files are missing, conversion still succeeds and preserves image URL references 3) Detailed logging with [CONVERT] prefix shows transfer progress. Test file: /app/backend/tests/test_convert_to_showcase.py

api_endpoints_tested.description: Converts a property lead to showcase listing with image transfer
scenarios_tested: Lead with existing image files (200, files copied)
Lead with missing image files (200, URL references preserved)

fix_verification.original_issue: When converting a property lead to showcase listing, only some images were transferred (6 of 12)
fix_verification.root_cause: The brittle os.path.exists() check was skipping images when files were missing
fix_verification.fix_applied: Removed os.path.exists() check, now attempts to copy all images with try/except to catch FileNotFoundError
fix_verification.verification_method: Created tests that simulate both scenarios: (1) files exist and are copied, (2) files missing but conversion succeeds with URL fallback
